Instructions for Use
Device description: The Sable Cochlear Implant is a cochlear implant. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Sable Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 Tesla only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Maximum spatial field gradient of 40 T/m.
- Scan in Normal Operating Mode.
- whole-body averaged SAR of 2 W/kg or less.
The image artifact extends approximately 10 mm from the device.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
